intro.label: Gonarra assistant
intro.body: Tell me a few details and I'll suggest a 1–3 day plan from source-checked places. Anything found on the web is clearly labelled.

mode.label: How do you want to describe your trip?

mustSee.label: Must-see places (optional)
mustSee.max: You can add up to 10 places.
mustSee.title: Places in {{city}}

describe.prompt: What kind of trip do you want?
describe.label: Your trip
describe.placeholder: "3 slow days in Hanoi, street food"
describe.hint: Include the city, start date and number of days. You can switch to Form at any time.

notice.title: What is sent to AI?
notice.body: Your request text goes to an external AI service (Google Gemini). Your account, contact details and precise location do not.

validation.startPast: The start date must be today or later.
validation.hours: The end time must be after the start time.
validation.modes: Choose at least one way to get around.
validation.text: Describe your trip or use the form.

question.start_date: Which day does your trip start?
question.day_count: How many days is your trip?

clarify.disabledReason: Answer the question above to continue.

unsupported.body: This request is not supported yet. A trip is 1–3 days in one city: Hà Nội, TP.HCM, Đà Nẵng, Hội An or Huế.

progress.title: Creating your {{city}} proposal

stages.RESEARCHING: Searching the web for more places
stages.VERIFYING_WEB_PLACES: Checking places found on the web
stages.WRITING: Writing why each stop was chosen

progress.reassurance: Usually under a minute. You can leave this screen; the proposal will wait for you.
progress.missing: This request is no longer available. Start a new trip.
progress.heading: Planning your trip…

status.VALIDATING_REQUEST_1: Checking the city and trip length…
status.SELECTING_PLACES_1: Picking spots that match your interests…
status.RESEARCHING_0: Looking for more ideas on the web…
status.RESEARCHING_1: Reading the pages that were found…
status.VERIFYING_WEB_PLACES_0: Checking that each place really exists…
status.VERIFYING_WEB_PLACES_1: Web places will be labelled Not source-checked…
status.ROUTING_1: Working out travel times between stops…
status.SCHEDULING_1: Setting a time for every stop…
status.CHECKING_HEALTH_1: Making sure the days are not too packed…
status.WRITING_0: Writing a reason for each stop…

codes.ai_unavailable: The AI service is busy. Your saved trip is unchanged.
codes.quota_exceeded: You have used today's limit. Try again later.
codes.unsupported_request: This request is not supported yet.
codes.database_unavailable: The service is briefly unavailable. Try again.
codes.authentication_required: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
codes.revision_conflict: This draft changed elsewhere. Open it again to continue.
codes.trip_not_saved: Save this trip first, then try again.

when.title: When are you going?
when.hint: Tap the start date, then the end date. Up to 3 days.
when.max: Trips are up to 3 days. Pick an end date closer to the start.

notes.title: Must-sees and notes
notes.label: Anything else? (optional)
notes.hint: Your note is sent to the AI planner without your name or location.
notes.placeholder: E.g. sunset in Hội An, not too much walking

review.title: Review
review.hint: Tap a section to change it.
review.name: Trip name (optional)

exit.title: Leave this screen?
exit.body: Your choices are kept for this session.
